yacht.metaDescription: Luxury yacht in Punta Cana for groups of 1 to 22: premium open bar, snorkeling, natural pool and VIP transfer. Saona or Catalina on request.
yacht.description: A day on a yacht for your group of 1 to 22 guests, with a premium open bar. Choose Punta Cana, Saona Island or Catalina Island, go snorkeling, swim in a natural pool and cruise along the beaches of Bávaro and Punta Cana. The transfer is VIP, with a drink included.
includes: Cruise along the Bávaro and Punta Cana beaches
notes: Destinations: Punta Cana, Saona Island or Catalina Island.
Lunch is optional and quoted separately.

buggies.metaDescription: 4-hour buggy tour through coffee and cocoa plantations, a cenote and Macao Beach, with transport and guide included.
buggies.description: A guided buggy ride through the Dominican countryside. You'll see coffee and cocoa plantations and their chocolate, take a dip in a blue-water cenote and finish by the sea at Macao Beach, one of the most famous beaches in the Caribbean.

snorkeling.metaDescription: Snorkeling in Punta Cana with round-trip transport, guide, gear and snack. Six departures a day.
snorkeling.description: Put on your mask and swim among colorful fish in crystal-clear water. Round-trip transport, a guide, snorkeling gear and a snack are included, with several departures throughout the day.

parasailing.metaDescription: Parasailing in Punta Cana every day, with departures from all hotels. Fly over the turquoise sea and see the coast from above.
parasailing.description: Take off from the boat and rise above the turquoise sea to see the Punta Cana coast from the air. There are departures every day, from all hotels.

speedboat.metaDescription: 3 h 30 min speedboat tour along the Bávaro and Punta Cana coast, with snorkeling and a natural pool. Sunset departure available.
speedboat.description: Speed along the Bávaro and Punta Cana coast, stop to snorkel and swim in a natural pool. The afternoon departure ends with the sunset.
includes: Tour of the Bávaro and Punta Cana coast

diving.metaDescription: Scuba diving in Punta Cana with guide, gear, transport, snack and lunch. Full day or exclusive morning schedule.
diving.description: Guided dives on the reefs of the Dominican Caribbean, among sea fans, sponges and fish. Gear, transport, a snack and lunch are included.

horseback.description: A horseback ride along country trails, past coffee and cocoa plantations, ending on the sand at Macao Beach.

zipline.description: Ten zip lines to glide over the tropical greenery, with round-trip transport included.
